name: קֶרֶן הַפּוּךְ
summary: Job gives this name to the third of his daughters born after his restoration. He grants the daughters an inheritance alongside their brothers.

evidence.note: The third daughter is named after Jemimah and Keziah.
The daughters receive an inheritance among their brothers.
The second element of the name denotes the paint Jezebel puts on her eyes.

note: The compound joins קֶרֶן ‘horn’ to הַפּוּךְ ‘the eye paint’.
